Elements of a Story","description":"

One bingo card; 25 twists, scenes, and elements; endless possibilities for story outcomes and genre selections. What story will you come up with? In this workshop, we're going to use bingo cards that lay out various twists, turns, and scenes to create the framework for a potential story. What may be literary fiction for one person could be a horror story in the making for the next. Will we go for a random draw or a blackout card challenge? Attend and find out! Those who want to participate can read aloud what they came up with.

*Expect a small surprise for the last workshop of 2026. See you again next year!

About The Instructor: Nikoletta Gjoni is a writer living outside of Washington, D.C. Much of her work delves into myth and folklore, historical fiction, and family lore and dynamics. Her work has been published in Atticus Review, Emerson Review, Alan Squire Publishing, The Ex-Puritan, and Cleaver Magazine, among others.
